environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate with CRYPTO_BACKEND=local, no HSM_SLOT_ID set, KEY_* environment variables not provisioned for all key IDs. Service runs with --reload and debug=True (uvicorn). No input validation on key_id parameter. Container has no resource limits and error responses include full exception context.

config.notes: Only KEY_DEFAULT is provisioned; any other key_id triggers null dereference
